# Sovereignty AI Studio Deploy — Frontend

Vanilla HTML / CSS / JS. System fonts only (`-apple-system`, `BlinkMacSystemFont`).

- No React, no Next.js, no Vite, no Tailwind, no PostCSS
- No Vercel, no Firebase, no third-party CDNs or font hosts
- No Segoe UI, no Microsoft or IBM typefaces
- Cursor pointer on every interactive element; `not-allowed` on disabled
- Pages: Dashboard, Podcast, Presentation, Story, Social, Writing, Alerts
